building.description: You are inside a building, a well house for a large spring.

road.description: You are standing at the end of a road before a small brick building. Around you is a forest.

valley.description: You are in a valley in the forest beside a stream tumbling along a rocky bed.

forest.description: You are in open forest, with a deep valley to one side.

slit.description: At your feet all the water of the stream splashes into a 2-inch slit in the rock. Downstream the streambed is bare rock.

depression.description: You are in a 20-foot depression floored with bare dirt. Set into the dirt is a strong steel grate mounted in concrete.

entrance.description: You are in a small chamber beneath a 3x3 steel grate to the surface. A low crawl over cobbles leads inward to the west.

cobbles.description: You are crawling over cobbles in a low passage. There is a dim light at one end and darkness at the other.

debris.description: You are in a debris room filled with stuff washed in from the surface. A low wide passage with cobbles becomes plugged with mud and debris here.

awkward_canyon.description: You are in an awkward sloping east/west canyon.

bird_chamber.description: You are in a splendid chamber thirty feet high. The walls are frozen rivers of orange stone. A cheerful little bird is singing.

pit_top.description: At your feet is a small pit breathing traces of white mist. A rough stone stairway leads down into the pit.

hall_of_mists.description: You are at one end of a vast hall stretching forward out of sight to the west. There are openings to either side. The hall is filled with wisps of white mist swaying to and fro.

hall_of_mountain_king.description: You are in the Hall of the Mountain King, with passages off in several directions.

west_side_chamber.description: You are in the west side chamber of the Hall of the Mountain King. A passage continues west and up here.

south_side_chamber.description: You are in the south side chamber. The walls are covered with prehistoric murals.

y2.description: A large room with the inscription 'Y2' on a rock in the room's center.

jumble.description: You are in a jumble of rock, with cracks everywhere.

window_on_pit.description: You're at a low window overlooking a huge pit, which extends up out of sight. A floor is indistinctly visible over 50 feet below.

dirty_passage.description: You are in a dirty broken passage. To the east is a crawl. To the west is a large passage.

brink_of_pit.description: You are on the brink of a thirty foot pit with a massive orange column down one wall.

low_passage.description: You are in a low passage at the edge of a large underground reservoir. Mist rises from the water.

long_hall.description: You are in a long hall with a rounded ceiling. Several passages lead off in all directions.

cross_over.description: You are at a crossover of a high N/S passage and a low E/W one.

dead_end_14.description: Dead end. A bricked-up doorway is visible in the east wall.

complex_junction.description: You are at a complex junction. A low hands-and-knees passage from the north joins a higher crawl from the east to make a walking passage going west.

bedquilt.description: You are in Bedquilt, a long east/west passage with holes everywhere. To explore at random select north, south, up, or down.

swiss_cheese.description: You are in a room whose walls resemble swiss cheese. Obvious passages go west, east, ne, and nw. Part of the room is occupied by a large bedrock block.

slab_room.description: You are in a large low room. Crawls lead north, se, and sw.

secret_canyon_n.description: You are in a secret N/S canyon above a large room.

secret_canyon_s.description: You are in a secret canyon at a junction of three canyons. A passage leads south to a wider passage.

troll_bridge.description: You are on one side of a large, deep chasm. A heavy white mist rising up from below obscures all view of the far side. A rickety wooden bridge spans the chasm. A burly troll stands by the bridge and insists you throw him a treasure before you may cross.

volcano_view.description: You are on the far side of the chasm. A southwest path leads to a glowing passage. The sound of a volcano can be heard to the south.

plover_room.description: You are in a small chamber lit by an eerie green light. An extremely tight passage leads north. A dark corridor leads west.

dark_room.description: You are in the dark-room. A corridor leads east to a dim light. A passage leads south.

shell_room.description: You are in a large room carved out of sedimentary rock. The floor and walls are littered with bits of shells imbedded in the stone. A shallow passage proceeds downward.

ragged_corridor.description: You are in a long sloping corridor with ragged sharp walls.

reservoir.description: You are at the edge of a large underground reservoir. The water appears quite deep. A dimly-lit passage leads south.

pirates_lair.description: You have found a large chamber deep in the cave. Pirate treasure is scattered everywhere!

maze_1.description: You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.

maze_2.description: You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.

maze_3.description: You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.

maze_4.description: You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.

maze_5.description: You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.

cave.note: Expanded Colossal Cave (350 points): 46 rooms. The grate between depression and entrance requires keys. The snake in Hall of the Mountain King requires the bird. The troll at the bridge demands a treasure. The pit at brink_of_pit requires rope. Dark rooms require the lamp, which has a limited battery (330 turns). The maze consists of identical-looking rooms.

lamp_battery.note: Remaining lamp battery turns. Starts at 330. Decremented each turn when the lamp is on (player is in a dark room with lamp). At 0 the lamp dies and darkness becomes lethal.

player_token.note: The adventurer's position marker, placed at current room node.

keys.note: Set of keys found in the building. Unlocks the steel grate.

lamp.note: Brass lantern found in the building. Required for dark rooms. Battery lasts 330 turns.

bird.note: A little bird in the bird chamber. Scares away the snake.

rope.note: A sturdy rope. Required to descend the pit at brink_of_pit.

pearl.note: A glistening pearl the size of a bird's egg.

persian_rug.note: A Persian rug of exquisite workmanship.

snake.note: A huge green fierce snake. Blocks passages in the Hall of the Mountain King.

grate.note: A locked steel grate between the depression and the entrance.

troll.note: A burly troll who demands a treasure to let you cross the bridge.

pit_obstacle.note: A thirty-foot pit that requires rope to descend safely.

move.constraint: target node is adjacent to current node
move.definition: Move the adventurer to an adjacent room.

pick_up.constraint: item is at current room AND item.portable == true
pick_up.definition: Pick up a portable item from the current room into inventory.

drop.definition: Drop an item from inventory into the current room.

use_keys.constraint: keys in inventory AND player at depression or entrance
use_keys.effect: grate.locked = false; passage between depression and entrance opens
use_keys.definition: Use keys to unlock the steel grate.

use_bird.constraint: bird in inventory AND player at hall_of_mountain_king
use_bird.effect: snake removed; passages from hall_of_mountain_king open
use_bird.definition: Release the bird to scare away the snake.

use_rope.constraint: rope in inventory AND player at brink_of_pit
use_rope.effect: pit_obstacle removed; passage from brink_of_pit to low_passage safe
use_rope.definition: Use rope to safely descend the pit.

pay_troll.constraint: treasure in inventory AND player at troll_bridge
pay_troll.effect: troll satisfied; passage across bridge to volcano_view opens; given treasure is consumed
pay_troll.definition: Give the troll a treasure to cross the bridge. The treasure is lost.

grate_blocks.trigger: move from depression to entrance OR entrance to depression
grate_blocks.definition: The locked grate blocks passage between the depression and the entrance.

snake_blocks.trigger: move from hall_of_mountain_king to west_side_chamber, south_side_chamber, or long_hall
snake_blocks.constraint: snake is not present at hall_of_mountain_king
snake_blocks.definition: The fierce snake blocks passage deeper into the cave.

troll_blocks.constraint: troll is not present at troll_bridge
troll_blocks.definition: The troll blocks passage across the bridge unless paid.

pit_blocks.constraint: pit_obstacle is not present at brink_of_pit
pit_blocks.definition: The deep pit at brink_of_pit blocks descent without rope.

darkness.trigger: move into a room with light == false
darkness.definition: Dark rooms require the lamp with battery remaining. Without it, you are likely to be eaten by a grue.

lamp_drain.trigger: each turn spent in a dark room with lamp
lamp_drain.definition: Each turn in a dark room drains one unit of lamp battery.

library.all_treasures_at_building: all treasures (gold_nugget, diamonds, silver_bars, rare_coins, ming_vase, pearl, golden_eggs, trident, persian_rug, spices) are at building node AND player is at building

end_conditions.condition: player in dark room without lamp or lamp_battery == 0
end_conditions.name: eaten_by_grue
